sourceLimits: Selected HEROES_DB portrait and production.audiovisual.portrait are the same V2 original-project bitmap; internal authority, not an external official source.

One portrait does not establish exact iris color, reverse garment/gauntlet construction, tiny jewellery geometry or chronological age. Preserve restrained continuations without claiming perfect1:1 certification.

New Aetherion places and poses are original compositions respecting seven measurable laws: form, cost, bond, memory, exchange, threshold, contradiction; blue and amber magic does not establish limitless canon powers.
CG05 is Nexus;09-11FanArt;12-15WhatIf. FirstStep at the same apparent age is a hypothetical first expedition, not an invented childhood.
Old atlas remains unchanged as a variant; current reference has large RIGHT gold gauntlet, navy scarf, ochre lining and flasks missing in old atlas.
